title: PERCE-MUCO: Perceptions and Expectations of People With Cystic Fibrosis Regarding a Change in Treatment
official: Perceptions and Expectations of Patients Regarding a Change in Treatment in Cystic Fibrosis (PERCE-MUCO)
summary: PERCE-MUCO is a prospective, multicentre, mixed-methods observational study investigating the perceptions, expectations and treatment-change intentions of adults with cystic fibrosis who are currently treated with elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor (ETI) or whose treatment has been medically discontinued. The study focuses on patients' stated willingness to switch from ETI to vanzacaftor/tezacaftor/deutivacaftor (VTD), and on the factors associated with this intention, including treatment satisfaction, knowledge and expectations regarding VTD, quality of life, treatment adherence, reported adverse effects, access-related concerns and desired support from an advanced practice nurse. The quantitative component uses a study-specific questionnaire and routine-care CFQ-R 14+ and Morisky-8 data. A qualitative component consists of semi-structured interviews at the Roscoff cystic fibrosis centre.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of cystic fibrosis
* Currently treated with ETI for at least 3 months, OR previously treated with ETI but treatment discontinued for medical reasons

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient objects to the use of their data for this project\\n•
* Currently receiving the new CFTR modulator VTD
